newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Economists see unchanged Danish Aug CPI.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Economists see unchanged Danish Aug CPI.

text.p: Economists expect Danish August year-on-year inflation data, to be published on Friday, to show no change from July's 2.3 percent, a Reuter consensus forecast showed on Wednesday.
The panel of nine economists was referring to data produced according to the Danish national formula. Using new EU-harmonised calculation methods July consumer prices rose 2.6 percent year-on-year.
Denmark's National Statistics Office publishes both figures at 0730 GMT on September 20. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
